name: DocuWare
description_en:
DocuWare is a product in the Document management category. Its directory profile covers Optical Character Recognition - OCR, Offline Access, File Type Conversion, File Recovery, e-Signature, Document Retention, Document Indexing, Document Assembly.

Additional listed capabilities include Document Archiving, Compliance Tracking, Collaboration Tools, Version Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: support shared work and communication between participants; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
